mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTH_TOKEN_STATE (TOKEN_HASH, USER_ID, TOKEN_TYPE, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, 'REFRESH', #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE AUTH_TOKEN_STATE SET REVOKED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND TOKEN_TYPE = 'REFRESH' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AUTH_TOKEN_STATE WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND TOKEN_TYPE = 'REFRESH' AND REVOKED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTH_TOKEN_STATE (TOKEN_HASH, USER_ID, TOKEN_TYPE, EXPIRES_AT, REVOKED_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, 'ACCESS', #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE REVOKED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AUTH_TOKEN_STATE WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND TOKEN_TYPE = 'ACCESS' AND REVOKED_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM AUTH_TOKEN_STATE WHERE EXPIRES_AT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
